text: There is no evidence available to determine if this asset is deforestation-free. The assessment shows "INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE" because the required Earth-observation data (e.g., Hansen GFC, JRC GFC2020) is missing for this asset. The tools checked for tree-cover loss from 2021–2025 but could not confirm or rule out any loss due to lack of coverage. No observations were made, meaning neither deforestation nor compliance can be established. Further data collection or alternative sources are needed for a conclusive answer.
